method.primary_denominator: Markey plus Moulton votes for two-party primary share
method.income_source: Census Reporter B19013, latest release recorded in coverage
method.tract_allocation: Each mapped VTD assigned by an interior point to one census tract; tract rows require at least 200 2026 ballots and valid income
method.boston_allocation: Mapped VTD interior points joined to Boston Planning Department neighborhood boundaries; these are planning boundaries, not official neighborhood boundaries
method.opportunity_filter: Emerging places are outside branch-core municipalities and have at least 5,000 ballots, an above-state PSL share, at least 25 votes above the statewide-rate expectation, and a positive residual from the weighted 2024 PSL/Stein/Harris baseline model
method.inference: Full vote counts are descriptive, not samples. Cluster bootstrap resamples municipalities. Demographic results are ecological and do not identify individual voters.
